columns.name: customer_auto_tagging_enabled
columns.comment: Whether auto-tagging is enabled for the customer.

columns.name: customer_currency_code
columns.comment: The currency in which the account operates. A subset of the currency codes from the ISO 4217 standard is supported.

columns.name: customer_descriptive_name
columns.comment: Optional, non-unique descriptive name of the customer.

columns.name: customer_manager
columns.comment: Whether the customer is a manager.

columns.name: customer_test_account
columns.comment: Whether the customer is a test account.

columns.name: customer_time_zone
columns.comment: The local timezone ID of the customer.
